title: See the alternative. Decide with context.
text: Page-by-page Project Design Review by Arik Aizikovich. A concrete comparison workspace for Codex and Claude Code.

title: More than one annotation
text: Annotate points to an element. Here, inspect the current screen beside a concrete alternative, explain why, and preserve the decision and history.

title: Give the details in your request
text: Describe the project, products, platforms, language and review mode in the skill run. The agent manages setup; you do not edit configuration files.

title: Continue without repeating the setup
text: Project settings are remembered locally. Continue the review reuses the same board; Switch to Brief changes only the requested setting.

title: One project. Products inside it.
text: Morrow is the project. Provider and Customer are its products. Their page inventory lives on the left; tools and discussions stay on the right.

title: Review each product journey
text: Switch to Customer to review discovery. Each page has its own current and suggested evidence, with the relevant product options.

title: Move page by page
text: Checkout is a different page, with its own comparison and decision. All records and payment details shown in this film are fictional.

title: Shared belongs to the project
text: When there is more than one product, Shared is always available. Review common account controls here, or show an honest empty state.

title: Choose each comparator independently
text: The left side can show Current or a previous revision. The right can show Suggested, another revision, or a labeled external reference.

title: Bring an external design into the comparison
text: An inspected Stitch export can be one side of the review. This film uses a clearly labeled mock Stitch reference.

title: The same workflow accepts other sources
text: A Claude design can also be compared without replacing earlier evidence. This reference is simulated too; source labels must stay honest.

title: Appearance is a separate choice
text: Light and Dark preserve the selected page and revision. Flags stay attached to their exact screenshot, including its appearance.

title: Check Android within its own context
text: In Mobile, choose Android, iOS or PWA where relevant. Start by comparing current and proposed within the same platform.

title: Then inspect iOS
text: Keep the task, state, data, locale, theme and revision aligned. Intentional native navigation and safe-area differences should be explained.

title: Compare the PWA on par
text: Judge equivalent information, primary actions and outcomes across platforms. These platform screens are simulations, not physical-device validation.

title: Language follows your request
text: Ask for any review language, including RTL. The agent localizes generated content. A missing product-locale capture stays missing; it is never silently relabeled.

title: Flag the exact element or image
text: A numbered flag records the exact source image and revision. Hover or keyboard focus opens its RichTip: target, note and source context.

title: Pointing is optional
text: Keyboard placement lets you choose the side and normalized position. General notes can describe the whole page without any coordinate.

title: Keep the page-level conversation clear
text: Use a general page note for hierarchy, flow or overall direction. Save and Export remain together in the bottom-right controls.

title: See through your flags
text: The visible opacity slider ranges from zero to one hundred percent. Your chosen opacity persists across pages, revisions and reloads.

title: A temporary peek with Ctrl
text: Hold Ctrl to hide flags and RichTips. Release it to restore your saved opacity. This is a display preference, not an annotation edit.

title: Open either side at full size
text: The full-size viewer loads both sides in the same frame. Flip with the button or Space and F; arrows select a side; Escape returns.

title: Flip instantly, one on top of the other
text: Switch without a fade or layout shift. The shared scale, origin and pan make the difference easier to inspect; mismatched dimensions are disclosed.

title: Brief keeps the review compact
text: Brief shows comparisons, provenance, concise scope, feedback and decisions. It avoids generating long explanations that were never requested.

title: Full explains the elements below
text: Full adds what exists, what changes, why, what to keep, accessibility considerations, platform parity, status and unresolved choices. Saved details match their review revision.

title: Preserve every iteration
text: First, Back, Next and Latest stay inside one board. Older screenshots, flags, notes and decisions remain available under their own revision.

title: Discuss in context
text: Open a discussion about the page, a part or a flag. The right drawer keeps that exact context while you explain the requested change.

title: A request can queue the next pass immediately
text: Request these changes and start saves a bounded prototype request in one action. This unconnected demo correctly shows Queued, not Working.

title: Keep reviewing while real work runs
text: With a connected agent, a claimed request can run in the background. A verified result becomes a new immutable revision; explicit historical views and unsaved notes remain selected.

title: Preview the prepared visual source
text: A prepared source opens as a preserved interactive snapshot. Try the fictional controls, then return to the review. New requests need an updated source.

title: An interaction is still a prototype
text: This button responds inside the isolated preview. No live booking, account or payment action is connected. Previewing does not approve the design.

title: Approval has precise meaning
text: Approved as-is accepts the shown design without requested edits. This is a demonstration reviewer action on disposable fictional data.

title: Acceptance with changes is a distinct decision
text: Approved with changes records acceptance of an edit scope. Changes requested remains pending feedback, separate from work authorization and deployment.

title: Reject without losing evidence
text: Reject declines the proposal while keeping notes and previews. Reopen lets the review continue; it never changes the shipping product.

title: Share this exact review
text: The link includes page, feedback revision, source pair, capture axes and detail mode. A loopback link is local; copying it does not publish the board.

title: A review you can return to
text: Use the same skill in Codex or Claude Code. Give your project details, inspect alternatives, request a bounded iteration, and continue with preserved context.
